[[/collapsible]]

Samurai Warriors 5 is the fifth mainline Samurai Warriors game and the first time where the series has had a major overhaul to its visual style as well as being the only entry in this era, this guide will go over character unlocking, stage objectives and where to go for the Rare Weapons.

Character Unlocking

This will list how to unlock all 39 (technically 37) characters.

Character Requirement
Nobunaga Oda Initially available.
Nobunaga Oda (Mature) Start Chapter 5.
Mitsuhide Akechi Clear Nobunaga 1-5 Battle of Nagara River.
Mitsuhide Akechi (Mature) Start Chapter 5.
Hideyoshi Hashiba Clear Nobunaga 2-^1 Battle of Inō.
Ieyasu Tokugawa Clear Nobunaga 1-4 Battle of Muraki Garrison.
Yoshimoto Imagawa Clear Reverie ^1 Annihilation at Okehazama.
Shingen Takeda Clear Nobunaga 3-v Invasion of Suruga.
Kenshin Uesugi Clear Mitsuhide 2-3 Joint Struggle with the Uesugi.
Motonari Mōri Clear Mitsuhide 5-v3 Battle of Kōzuki Castle Mōri Army.
Nagamasa Azai Clear Nobunaga 3-^2 Battle of Kannonji Castle.
Hisahide Matsunaga Clear 4-^1 Battle of Kanegasaki.
Nō Clear Nobunaga 1-4 Battle of Muraki Garrison.
Mitsuki Clear Nobunaga 4-^2 Battle of Anegawa River.
Toshiie Maeda Clear Nobunaga 1-4 Battle of Muraki Garrison.
Katsuie Shibata Clear Nobunaga 2-^3 Battle of Inabayama Castle.
Oichi Clear Nobunaga 2-^3 Battle of Inabayama Castle.
Toshimitsu Saitō Clear Nobunaga 3-^2 Battle of Kannonji Castle.
Shikanosuke Yamanaka Clear Nobunaga 3-^2 Battle of Kannonji Castle.
Hanbei Takenaka Clear Nobunaga 3-^2 Battle of Kannonji Castle.
Kanbei Kuroda Clear Nobunaga 5-^2 Battle of Shigisan Castle.
Kazuuji Nakamura Clear Nobunaga 4-^2 Battle of Anegawa River.
Sena Clear Nobunaga 3-v Invasion of Suruga.
Tadakatsu Honda Clear Nobunaga 2-v1 Mayhem in Mikawa.
Hanzō Hattori Clear Nobunaga 2-v1 Mayhem in Mikawa.
Sandayū Momochi Clear Nobunaga 2-v2 Battle to Build Sunomata Castle.
Takakage Kobayakawa Clear Mitsuhide 5-v3 Battle of Kōzuki Castle Mōri Army.
Magoichi Saika Clear Reverie ^2 Match in Eiroku.
Yasuke Clear Nobunaga 6-^1 Battle of Takatenjin Castle.
Nobuyuki Oda Clear Nobunaga 2-^1 Battle of Inō.
Motonobu Okabe Clear Nobunaga 4-v2 Battle of Mikatagahara Takeda Army.
Katsuyori Takeda Clear Nobunaga 3-v Invasion of Suruga.
Motoharu Kikkawa Clear Mitsuhide 5-v3 Battle of Kōzuki Castle Mōri Army.
Terumoto Mōri Clear Mitsuhide 5-v3 Battle of Kōzuki Castle Mōri Army.
Dōsan Saitō Clear Nobunaga 1-5 Battle of Nagara River.
Yoshitatsu Saitō Clear Nobunaga 2-^3 Battle of Inabayama Castle.
Yoshikage Asakura Clear Mitsuhide 4-4 Battle of Tonezaka.
Yoshiaki Ashikaga Clear Mitsuhide 4-3 Battle of Makishima Castle.
Fujihide Mitsubuchi Clear Mitsuhide 4-3 Battle of Makishima Castle.

Musou Mode

This will list the stages and which characters you are able to choose for those battles and any who may come in mid battle to be a partner, characters with their name in bold have an objective they are needed for.

Nobunaga’s Path

Chapter 1 Before the Dawn

1-1 Raid on the Imagawa

Playable: Nobunaga Oda

  1. The Battle Begins - Defeat the enemy troops (100).
  2. Heihachirō’s Brave Fight - Defeat Tadakatsu Honda.
  3. Imagawa Reinforcements - Defeat Motonobu Okabe and Yasuyoshi Asahina.
  4. The Ninja and the Noblewoman – Defeat Sena and Hanzō Hattori to prevent Nobuyuki Oda and Katsuie Shibata from being taken out.
  5. Mikawa Wavers (Special) – Defeat Hirotada Matsudaira and Masanori Naitō.

1-2 Assault on Mino

Playable: Nobunaga Oda

  1. Gaining a Foothold - Defeat Michikatsu Inoue to capture the Central Garrison.
  2. The Foolish and the Stubborn - Defeat Mitsuhide Akechi.
  3. The Viper’s Trap - Defeat Toshimitsu Saitō to protect the Oda Main Camp.
  4. We Three of Mino - Defeat Ittetsu Inaba, Morinari Andō, and Bokuzen Ujiie.
  5. The Young Strategist - Defeat Hanbei Takenaka.
  6. Echoes on the Battlefield - Defeat Mitsuharu Fuwa and the drum corps.
  7. Rematch - Defeat Mitsuhide Akechi.
  8. Nobuyuki’s Struggle (Bonus) - Defeat Michitoshi Nagai and the spear captains.
  9. Yoshitatsu the Opportunist (Special) - Prevent Yoshitatsu Saitō from infiltrating the Oda Main Camp.

1-3 Turmoil on Mt. Inaba

Playable: Nobunaga Oda

  1. Breaking through the Siege - Defeat the enemy troops to break through their siege (50).
  2. Caged Butterfly - Defeat Dōchin Takegoshi to assist Nō’s advance.
  3. The Spider’s Thread - Defeat Michitoshi Nagai and Morinari Andō.
  4. Toshimitsu’s Resolve - Defeat Toshimitsu Saitō.
  5. In the Depth of-Darkness - Defeat Ittetsu Inaba and Bokuzen Ujiie to open the Wooden-floored Room.
  6. Taking Precautions (Bonus) – Prevent Mataichi Sengoku from approaching Nō. [During Caged Butterfly enter the side room from the top, will not trigger if you or your partner goes past the bridge.]
  7. The Strategist behind the Pincer (Bonus) – Defeat Horinari Hineno. [Instead of going North after In the Depth of-Darkness head in the room right after to trigger.]
  8. A Genius General Lurks Beneath (Special) – Defeat Hanbei Takenaka. [Defeat the Gate Captain on the Right in the center area to trigger.]

1-4 Battle of Muraki Garrison

Playable: Ieyasu Tokugawa, Nō, Toshiie Maeda

  1. Breaking through the Western Garrison - Defeat Yasutomo Asahina and Chikanori Niino to break through the Western Garrison.
  2. Breaching the Imagawa Main Camp - Defeat Sena to break through the Imagawa Main Camp.
  3. Nobunaga Must Be Saved - Escort Nobunaga Oda to the retreat point.
  4. Rescuing Mitsuyasu (Bonus) – Defeat Sadamura Suganuma and Kagataka Yamada before Mitsuyasu Akechi is taken out.
  5. Oda Army Rescue Mission (Bonus) – Defeat Nobutada Fuji and Chikanaga Sekiguchi to prevent Nobumori Sakuma and Nobumitu Oda from being taken out.
  6. Burn Your Boats (Ieyasu Tokugawa Bonus) – Ieyasu Tokugawa must defeat the enemy troops surrounding the retreat point in order to assist the allies’ retreat. (100)
  7. The Supreme Ruler of Tōkai (Special) – Defeat Yoshimoto Imagawa.

1-5 Battle of Nagara River

Playable: Nobunaga Oda | Mitsuhide Akechi (mid battle)

  1. Father and Mitsuhide - Rendezvous with Mitsuhide Akechi to Rescue Dōsan Saitō.
  2. The Oda’s Crossing - Defeat the shield soldiers on the opposite bank.
  3. Yoshitatsu in the Way - Defeat Ittetsu Inaba and Moninari Andō.
  4. On the Edge of Despair - Defeat Michikatsu Inoue and Michitoshi Nagai to open the gates around Sagiyama Castle.
  5. A Diversion - Defeat the enemy troops at the Central Garrison. (100)
  6. The Lady and the Hostage - Defeat Sena and Ieyasu Tokugawa to reach the retreat point.
  7. So That We May Retreat (Bonus) - Defeat Bokuzen Ujiie and Mataichi Sengoku to open up a path to the retreat point.
  8. Father’s Ruin (Bonus) – Defeat Yoshitatsu Saitō.
  9. The Strategist’s Betrayal (Bonus) – Defeat Hanbei Takenaka.
  10. What He Left Behind (Bonus) – Defeat Motonobu Okabe and Yasutomo Asahina to prevent Nō from being taken out.
  11. The Supreme Ruler of Tōkai (Special) – Defeat Yoshimoto Imagawa. (2 minutes)

Chapter 2 The Vow

2-^1 Battle of Inō

Playable: Nobunaga Oda, Hideyoshi Hashiba, Nō, Toshiie Maeda This stage has 10 objectives, but the most that can be counted at once is 9. Breaking through the Center requires Toshiie Maeda while Toshiie’s Assault requires him to not be chosen.

  1. Destroying the Front Line - Defeat the enemy troops to advance the Nobunaga army’s front line. (150)
  2. Blazing a Trail - Defeat Torazō Ōwaki and Heishirō Kanbe to clear the back road.
  3. Striking at the Enemy’s Morale - Defeat the commanding officer, Hidesada Hayashi.
  4. A Sister’s Wish - Defeat Oichi to clear a path to Suemori Castle.
  5. A Demon of a Dead-End - Defeat Katsuie Shibata.
  6. A Foothold for Victory (Bonus) – Defeat Shingo Tsunoda and Sukenojō Kamata to capture the Central Western Garrison and Northeastern Garrison.
  7. Where, Oh Where Is the Back Road? (Hideyoshi Hashiba Bonus) - Hideyoshi Hashiba must reach the back road.
  8. Breaking through the Center (Toshiie Maeda Bonus) – Toshiie Maeda must defeat the enemy troops in the Central Garrison to break through the center of their formation. (100)
  9. Toshiie’s Assault (Bonus) – Defeat Mimasakanokami Hayashi to clear the central path.
  10. Mighty Spear Mataza (Special) – Defeat Jūzō Hashimoto and Sakyōnoshin Tomino. [Approach after Kurando Tsuzuki and Matajirō Yamaguchi are defeated opening the Central Garrison, Toshiie must not be a chosen character.]

2-^2 Battle of Okehazama

Playable: Nobunaga Oda | Toshiie Maeda (mid stage)

  1. Ambush on Dengakuhazama - Defeat Tadatsugu Sakai, Ienari Ishikawa, and Tadazane Honda to ambush Dengakuhazama.
  2. The Anticipated Ambush - Defeat Hanzō Hattori and his allies.
  3. The Leader of the Tokugawa Clan - Defeat Ieyasu Tokugawa.
  4. The Comeback - Defeat Sena and her allies to prevent Katsuie Shibata, Hideyoshi Hashiba, and Oichi from being taken out.
  5. Fools Don’t Know When to Quit - Attack enemy troops until the preparations are complete. (150)
  6. The Tokugawa Clan’s Path - Defeat Sena.
  7. Reclaiming the Garrison (Bonus) – Defeat Naomori Ii and Yasutomo Asahina to recapture Washizu Garrison and Marune garrison.
  8. The Tokugawa Army Supply Soldiers (Bonus) - Defeat all the Supply Captains to cut off the Imagawa Army’s supply lines.
  9. The Successor to Samonji (Nobunaga Oda Bonus) - Nobunaga Oda must defeat Yoshimoto Imagawa with a Musou Attack.
  10. To Command the Imagawa (Special) –Defeat Motonobu Okabe.

2-^3 Battle of Inabayama Castle

Playable: Nobunaga Oda, Nō, Toshiie Maeda, Katsuie Shibata, Oichi

  1. Forward March to Sunomata Castle - Defeat Yoshitaka Endō and Masanari Nonomura to advance toward Sunomata Castle.
  2. Sunomata Castle Must Not Fall - Prevent Sandayū Momochi from being defeated until the allied officers arrive. (2 minutes)
  3. Yoshitatsu Struggles - Defeat Mitsuharu Fuwa and his allies.
  4. The Tactician Attacks - Defeat Michitoshi Nagai and Sekian Takei to prevent Hideyoshi Hashiba from being taken out.
  5. Join Us, My Friend! - Defeat Hanbei Takenaka.
  6. Stopping the Saitō Army Reinforcements (Bonus) – Defeat Hironari Hineno to prevent the arrival of enemy reinforcements.
  7. To Strike from Behind (Bonus) - Defeat Yorimoto Toki and Naomitsu Takegoshi to prevent Nobumori Sakuma from being taken out.
  8. Farewell to the Past (Nō Bonus) – Nō must defeat Yoshitatsu Saitō with a Musou Attack.
  9. A Wavering Heart (Special) - Defeat the surrounding enemy troops except for Ittetsu Inaba. (100) [Approach him near the start of the battle to hear him doubting Yoshitatsu to trigger.]

2-v1 Mayhem in Mikawa

Playable: (Main only) Ieyasu Tokugawa | (Partner only) Tadakatsu Honda, Hanzō Hattori.

  1. To Crush a Rebellion - Defeat Nobumoto Mizuno, and his allies, and prevent Tadayo Ōkubo and his allies from being taken out.
  2. The Pride of the Men of Mikawa - Defeat Sadayoshi Okudaira and Jinjirō Matsudira without taking out the peasant leaders.
  3. Recurring Rebellion - Defeat Sadakatsu Okudaira and Chikanori Matsudaira to crush the rebellion.
  4. Lady Sena’s Rescue - Defeat Hideyoshi Hashiba, Yoshinari Mori and Nobushige Suzuki, and prevent Sena from being taken out.
  5. Budding Romance - Work with Sena to defeat Katsuie Shibata.
  6. Attack of the Wanderers (Bonus) - Prevent any wanderers from infiltrating Okazaki Castle.
  7. The Wanderers Return (Bonus) - Defeat all wanderers to clear a path to the Southern Garrison.
  8. The Demon Shibata and the Mighty Men of Mikawa (Ieyasu Tokugawa Bonus) - Ieyasu Tokugawa must defeat Katsuie Shibata with a Musou Attack.
  9. Okazaki Castle under Threat (Special) - Prevent Sadatomo Okudaira and Takakiyo Miyake from infiltrating Okazaki Castle.

2-v2 Battle to Build Sunomata Castle

Playable: (Main only) Hideyoshi Hashiba | (Partner only) Sandayū Momochi

  1. The Battle to Erect Sunomata Castle – 1 - Secure your supplies by escorting the supply captains to Sunomata.
  2. The Battle to Erect Sunomata Castle – 2 - Secure your personnel by escorting the engineer captains to Sunomata.
  3. Pelting Down - Defeat Yorimoto Toki and his allies to complete Sunomata Castle.
  4. One Thing after Another - Defeat Michitoshi Nagai and his allies to defend Sunomata Castle.
  5. Getting Ahead (Hideyoshi Hashiba Bonus) – Hideyoshi Hashiba must defeat the enemy troops. (500)
  6. The Joy of Castle Construction (Bonus) – Defeat the enemy troops north of the Oda Main camp to advance the front lines. (100, 2 minutes) [During The Battle to Erect Sunomata Castle head North of the main camp to trigger.]
  7. Defend It with your Life (Sandayū Momochi Bonus) - Sandayū Momochi must defeat the enemy troops surrounding Sunomata castle to deploy the shield soldiers. (150, 2 minutes)
  8. When No One’s Home (Special) – Defeat Ittetsu Inaba, Bokzen Ujiie, and Morinari Andō to defend the Oda Main Camp.

Chapter 3 Soaring

3-^1 Battle of Northern Ōmi

Playable: Nobunaga Oda

  1. Thwarting the Azai Army Ambush - Defeat Kiyosada Amenomori and Naotsune Endō to stop the Azai Army’s ambush preparations. (2 minutes)
  2. Hanbei Considers - Defeat all the spear captains to capture the Eastern Garrison.
  3. Breaching Yamazakimaru - Defeat Tsunachika Kaihō and Naoyori Shinjō to open the Yamazakimaru gate.
  4. Take Out the Azai Officers - Defeat Sadayuki Atsuji and Ujinao Imamura.
  5. Deer Hunter - Defeat Shikanosuke Yamanaka to advance toward the Odani Castle Main Ward.
  6. Reunion - Defeat Mitsuhide Akechi.
  7. Make the First Move (Bonus) - Defeat all the siege captains to prevent their attack.
  8. The Azai Army’s Lifeline (Bonus) - Defeat Kiyotsuna Akao to capture the Western Garrison.
  9. Shortcut to the Commander (Bonus) – Defeat the enemy troops on the south side of Kyōgokumaru. [Head through the center Western road to trigger, must be done before Deer Hunter triggers.]
  10. A Head-On Battle (Nobunaga Oda Bonus) - Nobunaga Oda must defeat Nagamasa Azai with a Musou Attack.
  11. A False Start (Special) - Defeat Kazumasa Isono and Ujitane An’yōji.

3-^2 Battle of Kannonji Castle

Playable: Nobunaga Oda, Mitsuhide Akechi, Hideyoshi Hashiba, Ieyasu Tokugawa, Nagamasa Azai, Nō, Toshiie Maeda, Katsuie Shibata, Oichi, Toshimoto Saitō, Shikanosuke Yamanaka, Hanbei Takenaka. This stage has 14 objectives, but the most that can be counted at once is 12. For His Protection & A Show of skill are Oichi exclusive while The Skilled Men of Rokkaku & What Must Be Protected require her not to be chosen.

  1. A Stepping Stone to Kannonji Castle - Defeat Katamori Shindō, Shigemochi Mikumo, and Kimio Fuse to capture the Kannonji Castle fort.
  2. Seizing Mitsukuri Castle - Defeat Tomomichi Iwanari and Shigemasa Yoshida to capture Mitsukuri Castle.
  3. Attack of the Ninja - Defeat Mitsuki, and prevent Yoshiaki Ashikaga from being taken out.
  4. The Mysterious Assassin - Defeat Kazuuji Nakamura to dispel the Oda Army’s confusion.
  5. Seizing Wadayama Castle - Defeat Nagayasu Miyoshi and Jibunotifu Tanaka to capture Wadayama Castle.
  6. Elimination - Defeat all of Kazuuji Nakamura’s doubles to advance toward Kannonji Castle.
  7. By Your Side Once More (Nobunaga Oda Bonus) – Nobunaga Oda must work with Mitsuhide Akechi to defeat the enemy troops.
  8. What Must Be Protected (Bonus) – Defeat the enemy troops to rescue Yoshiaki Ashikaga. [Stay near Yoshiaki, after Kenshin appears and A Stepping Stone to Kannonji Castle is cleared wait for him to mention Yoshiaki is the rightful heir to the Shogunate. Oichi must not be a chosen character.]
  9. Enemy Attack from the North (Bonus) – Defeat Sadahime Gamō and Katahide Gamō.
  10. Enemy Attack from the Center (Bonus) – Defeat Masakatsu Miyoshi and Nagafusa Shinohara.
  11. A Desperate Defense at Mitsukuri Castle (Bonus) – Defeat Yoshiharu Rokkaku, Sadatake Hirai, and Sanefusa Ogura to prevent Mitsukuri castle from being recaptured.
  12. The Skilled Men of Rokkaku (Bonus) – Defeat Yoshisada Rokkaku, Sadakage Namazue, and Takaharu Gotō to assist your allies’ advance.
  13. For His Protection (Oichi Bonus) – Oichi must defeat Yoshisada Rokkaku and his allies, and prevent Nagamasa Azai from being taken out.
  14. A Show of Skill (Oichi Special) – Oichi must defeat the enemy troops, and prevent Yoshiaki Ashikaga from being taken out. (100, 3 minutes) [As Oichi have her near Yoshiaki as early as possible.]

3-^3 Battle of Rokujō

Playable: Nobunaga Oda, Nagamasa Azai, Nō, Katsuie Shibata, Oichi.

  1. Unexpected Reinforcements - Defeat Yoshikata Rokkaku and his allies.
  2. A Saitō Never Quits - Prevent Tatsuoki Saitō and his allies from approaching Yoshiaki Ashikaga.
  3. Making Use of Lord Saitō - Defeat Masayasu Sogō and his allies, and prevent the Captains of the Guard from being taken out!
  4. A Cleansing Fire - Escort all the engineer captains to each target point to prepare a fire attack.
  5. Flashy Attacks! - Defeat the enemy troops in the Honkokuji Western Garrison to throw the enemy into disarray.
  6. Suspicious Movements (Bonus) – Prevent Sadakage Namazue from reaching the escape point. [Don’t fully complete Unexpected Reinforcements and have someone near Sadakage Namazue’s position and approach him to trigger.]
  7. The Vulnerable Garrison (Bonus) – Defeat the Enemy troops in the Honkokuji Southwestern Garrison while the enemy’s defenses are weak. (100, 1 minute)
  8. Rescuing Murashige Araki (Bonus) - Defeat Yasunaga Miyoshi and Akimoto Hosokawa, and prevent Murashiga Araki from being taken out.
  9. Destroy Everything (Special) – Defeat all enemy officers. [Must have completed every objective to trigger.]

3-v Invasion of Suruga

Playable: Ieyasu Tokugawa, Shingen Takeda, Sena, Tadakatsu Honda, Hanzō Hattori, Katsuyori Takeda. This stage has 10 objectives, but the most that can be counted at once is 9. Thinking of Imagawa requires Sena while Sandayū’s Scheme requires her to not be chosen.

  1. Advancing on the Imagawa - Capture the garrisons in the east and west to surround the Imagawa Army.
  2. The Loyal Officer Remains - Defeat Motonobu Okabe and capture the Southern Garrison.
  3. One Fell Swoop - Defeat the nearby enemy troops to surround the Imagawa Main Camp. (150)
  4. The Tokugawa’s Looming Crisis - Defeat Kagetsuna Naoe, Tomonobu Saitō, and Shigeie Shibata before they infiltrate the Tokugawa Main Camp.
  5. The Takeda’s Looming Crisis - Defeat Kagemochi Amakasu and Saneyori Honjō before they infiltrate the Takeda Main Camp.
  6. Sandayū’s Scheme (Bonus) – Defeat Tadahisa Suganuma, Ujimoto Katsurayama, and Nobuteru Sena, and make them defect from the Imagawa Army. (3 minutes)
  7. Thinking of Imagawa (Sena Bonus) – Sena must defeat Tadahisa Suganuma and his allies, and make them defect from the Imagawa Army. (2 minutes)
  8. Dismal End (Bonus) – Defeat Ujizane Imagawa, and prevent his rendezvous with Kenshin Uesugi.
  9. A Righteous Man (Shingen Takeda Bonus) – Shingen Takeda must defeat Kenshin Uesugi before his health drops below 50 percent.
  10. Buried Threats (Special) – Defeat Yotarō Onikojima, and Nagahide Yasuda, and prevent Nobutada Anayama from being taken out.

Chapter 4 In Flux

4-^1 Battle of Kanegasaki

Playable: Nobunaga Oda, Hisahide Matsunaga, Nō, Toshiie Maeda.

  1. The Asakura’s Garrison - Defeat Kagamasa Maeba and Yoshitsugu Maeba to push forward the front line.
  2. Controlling Kanegasaki Castle - Defeat Kagetsuna Asakura, Kagetake Asakura, and Kageatsu Togano to capture Kanegasaki Castle.
  3. The Moving Battlefield - Naoyori Shinjō and his allies are after Nobunaga Oda. Defeat them.
  4. A Blocked Retreat - Defeat Kageakira Asakua and Naotsune Endō to capture the Northern Garrison.
  5. A Parting of Siblings - Defeat Oichi and Katsuie Shibata.
  6. Conquering the Fort (Bonus) – Defeat Kagekata Uozumi and Yoshiie Yamazaki to capture Tezutsuyama Caste (2 mins.)
  7. A Broken Pact (Bonus) – Defeat Yoshikaga Asakura.
  8. Friends in Need (Bonus) – Defeat Tsunachika Kaihō and his allies, and prevent Nagahide Niwa and his allies from being taken out.
  9. The Kindness of Acquaintances (Bonus) – Convince Mototsuna Kutsuki to defect to the Oda Army by defeating him.
  10. Nagamasa’s Decision (Special) – Defeat Nagamasa Azai.

4-^2 Battle of Anegawa River

Playable: Nobunaga Oda, Mitsuhide Akechi, Hideyoshi Hashiba, Ieyasu Tokugawa, Hisahide Matsunaga, Mitsuki, Toshiie Maeda, Toshimitsu Saitō, Hanbei Takenaka, Kazuuji Nakamura, Sena, Tadakatsu Honda, Hanzō Hattori, Sandayū Momochi. This stage has 11 objectives, but the most that can be counted at once is 10. A Mercenary’s Job requires Nobunaga Oda while A Mercenary’s Clutches requires him to not be chosen.

  1. Demon Shibata’s Pride - Defeat Katsuie Shibata and his allies.
  2. Clash at Anegawa River - Defeat the enemy troops to secure the front line. (100)
  3. Quickly and Carefully - Defeat Kagenori Asakura, Naotaka Magara, and Naozumi Magara before the Asakura Army notices you. (3 minutes)
  4. Cornering Yoshikage - Defeat Kagetake Asakura and his allies to advance toward the Asakura Main Camp.
  5. The Azai’s Raid - Prevent Naotsune Endō and Naoyori Shinjō from infiltrating the Oda Main Camp.

Rare Weapons

This will detail how to get the Rare Weapons of each weapon type, unlike usual games things are done differently here.

  • The difficulty must be Hard or higher.
  • You need to get an S rank in all four fields of Time, KO’s, Officer KO’s and Combo Count while also getting the S rank overall reward with the character mentioned, they can be the main character or partner and don’t even need to be used. This can be done in multiple runs and not just one as long as an S was scored at least once in each field.
  • It may seem like you have to pick one of the two stages to get a Rare Weapon, but no you have to do both stages with their required characters to get the weapon.
  • Whichever difficulty you choose you must get the S rank reward for it throughout your runs if it takes multiple, getting ASSS on Hard then SASS on Nightmare will not count.
  • A trick to keep your combo count in stages that have extremely high requirements or very long down times is to switch to your partner as it is fading out to reset the timer when you go back to your character.
